# PingBusiness Merchant Store Vibe Coding Kit

Purpose: customize and deploy a merchant-hosted PingBusiness store through a
conversational AI workflow.

Public kit: https://github.com/PingBusiness/PingBusiness/tree/main/merchant-store-vibe-coding-kit
Agent entry point: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PingBusiness/PingBusiness/main/merchant-store-vibe-coding-kit/AGENTS.md
Design workflow: design/DESIGN_AGENT.md
Design governing prompt: prompts/DESIGN_PROMPT.md
Deployment workflow: deployment/DEPLOY_AGENT.md
Deployment governing prompt: prompts/DEPLOY_PROMPT.md
Deployment input schema: deployment/deployment-input.schema.json
Deployment output schema: deployment/deployment-output.schema.json
Architecture: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Security: docs/SECURITY.md
Canonical backend behavior: source/estore-app/app.py
API specification: docs/ESTORE_APP_API_SPEC.md

Default public contract:
  https://<store-domain>/       merchant UI
  https://<store-domain>/api    estore-app through the private edge
  https://<store-domain>/auth   Keycloak through the private edge

Never place merchant credentials, API keys, client secrets, database
credentials, administrative credentials, or DNS/hosting tokens in browser code
or public reports.
